- **DevOps & Cloud:** Vercel, Docker, AWS (S3, EC2), CI/CD pipelines, Git/GitHub.

## Shipped Case Studies & Production Proof of Work
- **Dara Express** (https://daraexpress.com): Cross-regional logistics tracking and delivery operations portal. Unified live package tracking dashboard, automated dispatch invoicing, 40% reduction in booking dispatch errors.
- **blynQe** (https://blynqe.online): High-performance mobile dating and social platform with 500,000+ users worldwide. Minimalist, calm UX built with Next.js and Node.js.
- **Noteable** (https://noteable-kappa.vercel.app): Local-first, 100% on-device AI workspace running Transformers.js and IndexedDB without cloud data leakage.
- **Comtranz Global**: Commercial transport and fleet logistics portal managing driver schedules, payloads, and automated SMS/email alerts.
